subject: Zoda
text: Zoda cannot attack diagonally, so standing one square diagonal from him is a weakness.

evidence.quote: Zoda has a weakness when he's 1 diagonal away since he can't attack diagonally.

subject: Zoda
text: Having a 2x2 and controlling it well makes Zoda not too bad.

evidence.quote: As long as you have a 2x2 and control it well it's not too bad.
